asset_heavy.reason: Software and ad-tech platform with SDK integrations and on-device software; no plants or fleets needed to grow.

big_ticket.reason: Ad campaigns, installs and monetization are bought in frequent, small transactions, not large infrequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertisers' ad and user-acquisition budgets are easily cut in downturns; revenue depends on advertising spend.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are carriers, OEMs like Samsung and Xiaomi, large advertisers and big app publishers.

notes: Based on recognition of Digital Turbine as a mobile ad-tech and app distribution company; consumers are end users, not payers.

offers_products.reason: Sells software platforms: DT Exchange, Ignite/Launchpad, SingleTap, and an SDK-based ad and monetization stack.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes mainly from platform-based advertising and distribution technology, not staff-delivered work for customers.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its technology platform, SDK network and on-device placements, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Advertisers, publishers and carriers/OEMs keep running campaigns and ad monetization on an ongoing basis, with repeat spend.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are advertisers, app developers, publishers, carriers and OEMs; device users receive ads but don't buy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to advertisers, app developers, publishers, carriers and device makers (OEMs).
